method: Each member's asserts were read in full and listed in asserts_read. Each was searched by predicate against the 119 server-leg checks of docs/conformance/in-scope-2026-07-28.json (totals.by_leg.server), and against the pinned harness where a near miss or an unscored scenario exists; the unscored population searched is every server-leg scenario the frozen set runs and does not score (unscored_server_scenarios, added in correction round 1). A member that asserts an axis of an in-scope check, directly or by entailment (ratified 29735, Q6), in agreement OR in contradiction, has a missed edge (the MES-119 shape) and is redundant, routed to A3; redundant takes precedence over the counterfactual [authored 29733/29734 | ratified 29735, Q5]. Every row then records ONE counterfactual [authored 29707 N5 | ratified 29708], asked of the member at wire-meaning grain [authored 29713 | ratified 29717], excluding incidental traffic (29735 Q8), with equivalent wire forms firing (29799). Outside redundant and wrong_against_spec, a row whose reading fires is not_a_conformance_claim, routed to A2; one that does not fire names the spec text that makes it so and is genuine extra coverage. wrong_against_spec is reserved for a unit asserting what the spec forbids or contradicts. Every firing line was MEASURED by a scratch lib/ mutation realising the stated alternative (`mutations`), in a throwaway worktree restored lib/-clean after each, and names the innermost test-body frame; where ExUnit reports the frame at an enclosing capture_log or `for`, the row says so and names the failing assert, and where a member fails in its describe's setup before its body runs, the row names the setup line. Every row states its relation to OC in `oc_relation`: covered and scored, covered and not scored, or not covered [ratified 29808, Q1].

wire_schema_valid.check: WireSchemaValid validates every JSON-RPC message the implementation sent during its own scenario against that revision's schema (wsv_emit); an in-scope server-leg instance is emitted for each feature scenario, and the 2026-07-28 schema is the bundle mapped to F (schema_map, f_const).
wire_schema_valid.call_tool_result: SILENT on structuredContent. The 2026-07-28 CallToolResult (ctr_def) types structuredContent with a description and no `type` (sc_type: any JSON value, null included), so no value, and neither its presence nor its absence, can agree with or contradict the schema: the W-1 asserts on structuredContent entail no WireSchemaValid axis, and no edge is added.
wire_schema_valid.discover: SILENT: no in-scope WireSchemaValid validates a server/discover response. ServerCapabilities.extensions is typed as an object of JSONObject values (caps_ext), the shape :223 and the verbatim-object asserts read, but on the stateless connector a scenario sends server/discover only when it calls discover() (lazy_discover), and the class body of every scenario carrying an in-scope server-leg WireSchemaValid contains no discover() call and no server/discover literal (measured by search over those bodies at the pinned build). The scenarios that do send server/discover (server-stateless, dns-rebinding-protection, tasks-capability-negotiation) carry no in-scope WireSchemaValid. So the extensions-typing asserts entail no axis of a check that runs on that response, and no edge is added.

incidental_traffic.rule: A reading fires when a conforming SDK's ASSERTED value could differ in form or meaning.
